win.systemMonitor.cpuTemperatureUnavaila: Windows has no built-in way to read the CPU temperature without a sensor driver, and this app never installs one.
win.systemMonitor.cpuTemperatureNeedsAdm: This PC reports a temperature only to administrators. Run the app as administrator to see it.
win.systemMonitor.cpuTemperatureNeedsDri: To read the CPU's own sensors, install the PawnIO driver (pawnio.eu) and the sensor helper in Settings › Monitor.
win.systemMonitor.cpuTemperatureNeedsHel: To read the CPU's own sensors, install the sensor helper in Settings › Monitor.
win.systemMonitor.sensorHelperCaption: Reads the CPU's own temperature sensors from a small background process with administrator rights, so the app itself does not need them. Windows asks for permission once.
win.systemMonitor.sensorHelperInstalled: The helper is installed. It runs only while a CPU temperature is shown.
win.systemMonitor.sensorHelperDriverMiss: The PawnIO driver is not installed. The CPU's sensors cannot be read without it.
win.systemMonitor.sensorHelperFailed: The helper could not be set up.
win.systemMonitor.miniMonitorCaption: A small strip of your readouts that stays on top of other windows. Drag it anywhere and click a readout to see its details.
win.systemMonitor.miniMonitorClickThroug: Clicks reach the window below. Switch this off to move the mini monitor again.
win.systemMonitor.miniMonitorHideFullScr: Hide during full-screen apps, games and presentations
win.systemMonitor.toggleMiniMonitor: Show or hide the mini monitor
win.systemMonitor.readoutsCaption: Windows cannot show text next to tray icons. Pinned readouts appear in the tray icon's tooltip and in the mini monitor instead.
win.systemMonitor.trayTooltipCaption: Adds one line with the pinned readouts to the tooltip of the tray icon.
win.systemMonitor.readoutTokensCaption: Switch on what to show and use the arrows to set the order.
Strings.powerUnavailable: Power metrics unavailable on this PC
Strings.monitorOrderHint: Use the arrows to reorder the blocks and the eye to show or hide each one.
Strings.showCountdown: Show the remaining Keep Awake time in the tray tooltip and the readouts
monitorAlerts.notificationsDenied: Notifications for this app are off in Windows Settings, so alerts cannot appear.
settingsPages.monitorDescription: What the tray, the mini monitor and the panel show about your PC, and when to warn you.
